result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. Nothing is committed.

- **pkgdown/Doxygen/meta-generator HTML rules** (3 lines): `(html|html|xhtml)` → `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages are now covered.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML rule**: path `.*/[.]xml` → `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
- **`// Generated by` JS rule**: path `.*/[.]js` → `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **Gradle JS build rule**: `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` → `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

The path patterns are full-matched against the file path. So `build.gradle`, `.html`, `.xhtml` and the existing matches are unaffected, and the ordinary `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files still fall through to the other rules. The `<doc>` and generator-line content checks are unchanged.

Verification: `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest='*Scoping*,*Convention*'` completes with no errors. The module has no existing tests for these conventions, so that run exercises nothing new. I also could not run a direct check of the new matching against the compiled classes, because writing a scratch file to `/tmp` was denied. The regex behaviour above is reasoned from the full-match semantics, not executed.
